The Kaggle creation date therefore cannot establish initial public release, and no earlier official resource-release field was found.
records.resolution: Use the associated Healthcare publication date because the publisher metadata and abstract identify Brazil Glaucoma as a new public dataset, while the article's data-availability statement points to the original globaleyeh.com route. The 2025 Kaggle v1 date is a later mirror/archive signal.
records.notes: Date from the Healthcare article introducing Brazil Glaucoma. Its data availability statement points to globaleyeh.com.
